Amira Khan: Quick update — we're renaming the current Model Onboarding team to Model Lifecycle and moving it under Runtime to consolidate rollout + eval + serving handoffs. No layoffs, just org alignment.
Diego Morales: I'll take interim lead for Model Lifecycle for ~6 weeks while we run the hire. Will keep a small slice on infra to keep things stable.
Priya Natarajan: Congrats Diego. Quick Q: who covers your infra responsibilities during the interim?
Diego Morales: Good Q. Raya is covering critical infra flows (oncall, capacity, deploy approvals). I'll keep control-plane ownership for now.
Raya Olson: Confirmed. I'll own oncall and capacity planning. Will post an interim oncall rota and a short handoff checklist in #eng-infra by EOD Thu.
Amira Khan: Hiring plan: req goes live today for "Senior Manager, Model Lifecycle" (IC+people manager mix). Lina is the recruiter. Target interview loop 34 weeks. JD + banding in the shared drive.
Lina Chavez: On it. Please drop referrals here or DM me. I'll push the posting to #jobs in ~20m. Also please add must-have vs nice-to-have in a reply to help prioritize outreach.
Priya Natarajan: Any SLA/customer impact we should flag proactively?
Amira Khan: No immediate SLA changes. If we see capacity issues we'll flip affected traffic to Dedicated fallback and notify CS owners. Ops playbook will be updated with the temporary escalation flow.
Diego Morales: I'll draft a 1-pager runbook that lists: what Im handing to Raya, what stays with Runtime, and who to page for model rollbacks. Planning a 30-min cross-functional sync Tue 10:00 to align product/infra/CS.
Raya Olson: Adding a checklist to the runbook for incident triage + links to the PagerDuty rotations. Will also update the escalation matrix tonight.
Amira Khan: FAQ to reduce questions: 1) Compensation changes? No immediate changes. 2) Promotions/levels? Follow normal review cycles. 3) Questions/concerns? Reply here or DM People Ops.
Lina Chavez: Recruiter note: please post hiring bar and three top priorities for the role in a comment — helps with screening.
Diego Morales: Thanks all 680 Appreciate the quick coverage, Raya. Will keep everyone posted on candidacy progress.
Amira Khan: I'll upload the small org chart fragment and the new reporting lines in #people-ops after this thread.
